newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Corona-Lotus buys Artal Group unit.
newsitem.headline: Corona-Lotus buys Artal Group unit.

text.p: Belgian bakery products group Corona-Lotus said on Tuesday it bought NV Cremers from Eurobake SA, part of the Artal Group, on July 7 for undisclosed terms.

Cremers had 1996 turnover of 816 million Belgian francs and employs 135 people. Tough competition and price pressures meant it lost 71.4 million francs after extraordinary costs and financial charges in 1996. The operating loss stood at 2.2 million.
Corona-Lotus said the integration of waffles and cakes maker Cremers in its group would give the company the best chances to ensure its future.
Corona-Lotus would also take over the commercialisation of Eurobake in Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg.
It said both deals would strengthen its position in the Benelux and other markets.
Artal is known as the main shareholder of bourse-listed Belgian pralines group Neuhaus.
